title: About
text: This site collects research notes, technical essays, project updates, and short reflections on how machine learning systems behave once they meet real deployment conditions.

title: About
text:
Academic Profile
My current interests center on machine learning systems that operate over time: online graph prediction, fairness under feedback, robust evaluation, and methods for understanding when aggregate metrics hide important failures.

Working style
I use this site as a clean archive for ideas in progress: concise notes, equations, experiments, and project sketches that can later grow into papers or longer technical essays.
